Guest starring Sian Phillips and Ronald Pickup, with Kevin Whately and Laurence Fox

programme.title: Paul O'Grady: For the Love of Dogs

Later, Paul meets a group of dogs from a puppy farm who have had very little human interaction in the past, and need help learning how to socialise

programme.title: Mountain Vets

Helen has to respond to a call from her boss's husband about a difficult calving

Mr Grove is handed his final warning when he turns up to work late again, Henri receives a job offer and Rose finds Gordon's collection of racy photos
